summary: Iteration 14 - LIVE Lightspeed X-Series integration verified end-to-end with real Personal Token against redleafssports store. All 6 backend pytest cases passed (API_VERSION=2026-07, settings persistence, live test-connection returns connected=true, live categories fetch returns 58 categories with correct structure, OAuth authorize URL, disconnect endpoint). Frontend Settings page shows success toast 'Connected to Lightspeed Retail (redleafssports) via Personal Token. API v2026-07.' after clicking Test Connection. Category Mapping page successfully switches to Lightspeed platform, fetches 58 real categories (Archived, Batting Gloves & Inners, Cricket Balls, English Willow Bats, etc.) and displays them with Category ID / Category Name / Visible columns.

issues: Target Platform dropdown labels the Lightspeed option as 'Lightspeed eCom' while the integration is actually Lightspeed Retail (X-Series). The Settings page correctly uses 'Lightspeed Retail (X-Series)'. Consider renaming the dropdown label to 'Lightspeed Retail' or 'Lightspeed (X-Series)' for consistency and to avoid confusion with Lightspeed eCom, which is a different product line.

passed_tests: POST /api/settings/lightspeed/test returns connected=true with live Personal Token (redleafssports)
GET /api/categories/lightspeed returns 58 real categories with keys lightspeed_category_id, category_name, parent_id, leaf_category, category_path
GET /api/lightspeed/oauth/authorize returns valid URL with client_id, state, response_type=code, scope
POST /api/lightspeed/oauth/disconnect clears tokens and returns success
Frontend Settings: Test Connection button triggers real API call and shows success toast with domain + API version
Frontend Category Mapping: Platform dropdown switch to Lightspeed + Sync Categories from Lightspeed fetches and renders 58 real categories in a table
action_items: (Minor) Rename Category Mapping dropdown label from 'Lightspeed eCom' to 'Lightspeed Retail' or 'Lightspeed (X-Series)' to match Settings page terminology and avoid confusion with the separate Lightspeed eCom product.
critical_code_review_comments: lightspeed_service.py get_categories() correctly handles the 2026-07 nested response structure data.data.categories[] with fallback for older list format - implementation matches spec.
OAuth _oauth_states remains an in-memory dict; not multi-worker safe, but acceptable for preview/single-worker.
FRONTEND_URL still defaults to '' silently in routes/lightspeed.py; if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing, OAuth callback URLs would break silently - consider failing fast.
Category Mapping UI uses inconsistent 'Lightspeed eCom' label vs 'Lightspeed Retail (X-Series)' on Settings page.
seed_data_creation: Persisted Lightspeed credentials (domain=redleafssports, personal_token, client_id, client_secret) into settings via PUT /api/settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Lightspeed Retail X-Series (redleafssports) integration is fully working with Personal Token auth. Real store has 58 categories. To avoid disturbing the live store, do NOT execute /api/sync/lightspeed/{supplier_id} against real product data. The disconnect test wipes OAuth access/refresh tokens only, not the Personal Token (which lives in lightspeed_secret_token). If PostgreSQL crashes: pg_ctlcluster 15 main start. Login returns 'token' field. Key data-testids: login-username, login-password, login-submit, test-lightspeed-btn, connect-lightspeed-oauth-btn, disconnect-lightspeed-btn.
